errors.evidence: The plot shows two separate data points in this region. The peak is at approximately alpha = 0.5 with a value just below 23.75%. The data point at alpha = 1 has a value of approximately 23.4%, which is not the peak.
The final data point on the line is positioned at alpha = 5 on the x-axis, not at alpha = 4, which is only a tick mark.
